get_handlers_from_field_descriptors: parse field descriptors from a dataset header and return the corresponding field handlers
get_metadata_type_from_handlers: get the combined numpy dtype that describes a complete sample from a list of field handlers
use_TYPE_ID_HANDLER_map: look up the field handler class for a given type_id in the TYPE_ID_HANDLER mapping
define_HeaderType_dtype: define the numpy structured dtype for the dataset header with version, num_fields, page_size, num_samples, and alloc_table_ptr fields
define_FieldDescType_dtype: define the numpy structured dtype for field descriptors with type_id, name, and arguments fields
